name: TC-863: @scenario S1 Wings + Fries + one of three gyros — choices added to the line (Done never pressed); customer picks 10 pc + Lamb: the size is an upgrade, the combo price stays fixed
description: The owner-reported combo. Build: Combo price → Wings, Fries, then Chicken Gyro with '+ Add an option' adding Lamb and Beef Gyro as options (each applies at once; Done is never pressed), $21.99, Save and turn on. Read back: three lines, the third with exactly the three gyro options. Edit: price → $22.49. Lima: Wings 10 pc (+$3 over the 8 pc default) and Lamb (pricier than the cheapest gyro) → deal $22.49, upgrades $3.00. Wind: the customer leaves the default 8 pc and picks Lamb → deal $22.49, upcharge $0, no upgrades line. Both: You're saving = $26 regular − $22.49. Expected to FAIL at the build on a dashboard without RestauNax #974 (the choices are dropped, so the form prices Wings + Fries alone at $14 and refuses $21.99); not fixme'd — it goes green with that fix.
